# The Vibe Suite

> getvibe.dev is the hub for The Vibe Suite — ten local-first, one-command companions for agentic coding CLIs like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. Your machine, your keys.

## Product

Each companion is a public npm package. You run it with one npx command on your own machine, next to your agent CLI. No dashboard, no cloud account, no SDK.

## Free tools

- [viberadio](https://getvibe.dev/viberadio): Your agent's output as audio — narration, podcast, or music. `npx viberadio-fm`
- [vibemovie](https://getvibe.dev/vibemovie): Your coding session as a short recap video. `npx vibemovie`
- [vibelive](https://getvibe.dev/vibelive): Multiplayer for agent terminals. `npx vibelive`
- [vibeshare](https://getvibe.dev/vibeshare): Share your live agent session by URL. `npx vibeshare-live`
- [vibedonate](https://getvibe.dev/vibedonate): Donate your spare local compute. `npx vibedonate`
- [vibedate](https://getvibe.dev/vibedate): Dating by token league. `npx vibedate`
- [vibeads](https://getvibe.dev/vibeads): Contextual dev-tool discovery for Claude Code. `npx vibeads`
- [vibenotifications](https://getvibe.dev/vibenotifications): Customizable notifications for Claude Code. `npx vibenotifications`
- [vibebrand](https://getvibe.dev/vibebrand): Tokenized brand/design system — CSS design tokens, fonts, and a brand kit. `npx vibebrand`
- [vibecodereview](https://getvibe.dev/vibecodereview): A council of AI models reviews your PR. `npx vibecodereview`

## Pricing

- Free. No paid plans, no account, no checkout.
